mapper.sql: id, user_id, username, event_type, status, description, object_type, object_id, before_data, after_data, ip_address, user_agent, request_id, failure_reason, duration_ms, affected_records, created_time, archived, remarks
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, username, event_type, status, description, object_type, object_id, before_data, after_data, ip_address, user_agent, request_id, failure_reason, duration_ms, affected_records, created_time, archived, remarks) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{eventType}, #{status}, #{description}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{beforeData}, #{afterData}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{requestId}, #{failureReason}, #{durationMs}, #{affectedRecords}, #{createdTime}, #{archived}, #{remarks})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM audit_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = #{eventType} ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM audit_log WHERE ip_address = #{ipAddress} ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM audit_log WHERE event_type IN ('PERMISSION_GRANT', 'PERMISSION_REVOKE', 'ROLE_GRANT', 'ROLE_REVOKE', 'SENSITIVE_OPERATION', 'ACCOUNT_LOCK', 'ACCOUNT_UNLOCK') ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log WHERE username = #{username} AND event_type = 'LOGIN_FAILED' AND created_time >= #{startTime}
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_log SET archived = TRUE WHERE created_time < #{archiveDate} AND archived = FALSE
